command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e
test "$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED"
OUT=/var/tmp/go-avatar-eye-identity-relief2-shadow
rm -rf "$OUT"; mkdir -p "$OUT"
python3 - "$OUT/buehne.candidate.html" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re,hashlib,sys
src=Path('buehne.html'); out=Path(sys.argv[1]); t=src.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e'
counts={}
def sub(pattern,repl,text,name,flags=0):
 new,n=re.subn(pattern,repl,text,flags=flags); counts[name]=n; assert n==1,(name,n); return new
# 1) All blink states use the already-generated eye-only relief2 assets.
assert t.count('/augen_blink/blink_')==2,t.count('/augen_blink/blink_')
t=t.replace('/augen_blink/blink_','/augen_blink_relief2/blink_'); counts['blink_path']=2
# 2) Permanent open-eye identity plate: reuse existing blink element, do not add a second transform authority.
t=sub(r'(#augen-blink\{[^}]*?)opacity:0(\})',r'\1opacity:1\2',t,'blink_css_idle_visible',re.S)
# 3) Glow sits above open-eye plate. Actual lid closure suppresses it in gazeSchritt below.
t=sub(r'(#pupillen-glow\{[^}]*?)z-index:4;',r'\1z-index:5;',t,'glow_z_order',re.S)
# 4) Special expressions no longer disable real photographed blinking.
t=sub(r'function blinzeln\(zeitplanNeu = true\)\{\s*if\(_sonderLaeuft\)\{\s*if\(zeitplanNeu\) blinzelWeiterPlanen\(\);\s*return;\s*\}',
      'function blinzeln(zeitplanNeu = true){',t,'remove_special_blink_block',re.S)
# 5) Blink completion restores canonical open eyes and keeps the eye identity layer present.
t=sub(r'\$\("augen-blink"\)\.style\.opacity = "0";\s*blinzelPhase = null;',
      '$("augen-blink").src = BLINK_BILDER[0];\n    $("augen-blink").style.opacity = "1";\n    blinzelPhase = null;',t,'blink_end_restore_open',re.S)
# 6) A special expression is not a reason to remove the canonical gaze glow; only actual lid closure is.
t=sub(r'\$\("pupillen-glow"\)\.style\.opacity = _sonderLaeuft \? "0" : String\(ziel\.opazitaet\);',
      '$("pupillen-glow").style.opacity = blinzelPhase ? "0" : String(ziel.opazitaet);',t,'glow_state_coupling')
# Fail closed on any accidental legacy semantics in candidate.
for bad in [
 '_sonderLaeuft ? "0" : String(ziel.opazitaet)',
 'if(_sonderLaeuft){\n    if(zeitplanNeu) blinzelWeiterPlanen();\n    return;',
 '/augen_blink/blink_'
]: assert bad not in t,bad
assert t.count('/augen_blink_relief2/blink_')==2
assert t.count('$("augen-blink").style.opacity = "1";')>=2
assert t.count('blinzelPhase ? "0" : String(ziel.opazitaet)')==1
out.write_text(t,encoding='utf-8')
print('SOURCE_SHA256',hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('CANDIDATE_SHA256',hashlib.sha256(t.encode()).hexdigest())
print('COUNTS',counts)
print('SOURCE_BYTES',len(src.read_bytes()),'CANDIDATE_BYTES',len(t.encode()))
print('LIVE_MUTATION=0')
PY
echo ===RELIEF2_EQ_SHADOW===
if test -d /var/tmp/go-avatar-eye-mask-shadow-v1/blink; then for f in augen_blink_relief2/blink_*.png; do b=$(basename "$f"); cmp -s "$f" "/var/tmp/go-avatar-eye-mask-shadow-v1/blink/$b" || { echo MISMATCH:$b; exit 1; }; done; echo ALL_12_RELIEF2_BYTE_IDENTICAL_TO_REVIEW_SHADOW=PASS; else echo REVIEW_SHADOW_DIR_MISSING; fi
echo ===CANDIDATE_SEMANTICS===
grep -n -E 'augen_blink_relief2|#augen-blink|#pupillen-glow|function blinzeln|pupillen-glow.*style.opacity|augen-blink.*style.opacity' "$OUT/buehne.candidate.html" | head -100
test "$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED"
echo SCOPE=SHADOW_HTML_ONLY_NO_LIVE_MUTATION
